title: At the bus stop
sentences: Excuse me, is this the bus to the city centre?
Yes, it is. It leaves at nine o'clock.

questions.explain: The first speaker asks about the city centre.

questions.prompt: What time does the bus leave?
How much is a ticket (in pounds)?

title: Booking a table
sentences: Good evening. I'd like to book a table for four people.
Certainly. Could I have your name?

questions.prompt: How many people is the table for?
What does the waiter ask for?

title: A change of plans
sentences: I'm afraid I can't make it to the meeting on Thursday.
That's a shame. Is something wrong?
My manager asked me to travel to another office.
No problem. Let's reschedule for next Monday.

questions.explain: The manager asked them to travel.

title: Remote working debate
sentences: Working from home has clearly increased my productivity.
I see your point, but I find it harder to collaborate.
That's fair. Perhaps a hybrid arrangement would suit us both.
Exactly. Two days in the office and three at home.

questions.prompt: What does the second speaker find difficult?
questions.explain: They find it harder to collaborate.
They propose and agree on a hybrid arrangement.
